GM , Blissful morning to you all 🌤️

🗣️ A warehouse robot is not failing because the model is dumb. It is failing because the aisle it is walking tonight is not the aisle it trained on last month.

That is the Physical AI bottleneck. World models need fresh, ground-level 3D spatial data from real places. Satellites see roofs. Mapping vans see roads. 

Neither is standing in a loading bay at 6 a.m. watching a pallet stack change. 

@vangrid_io is building the infrastructure for that missing layer: a smartphone capture network that collects spatial video on demand, reconstructs it into 3D, and anchors provenance on Base so a buyer can verify the data instead of trusting a slide.

Here is how that loop is supposed to work, as an illustration, not a named case study. 

A night-shift worker near a port opens the Vangrid app on the way home, accepts a bounty for a street the last scan missed, and walks the grid with a phone. Faces and plates blur on-device. 

The capture is hashed with time and coarse location, batched, and attested onchain. Later a robotics team is not guessing from old street view. 

They are buying a verified observation of that exact corner, settled in USDC through the protocol.

This is not a future sketch. The web and Android products have been live since July 2026. 

The explorer is showing more than a million captures anchored, thousands of attestations, hundreds of thousands of dollars settled, and a growing node count. Check explorer dot vangrid dot io before you quote a number; the grid is moving.

Behind it is an Amsterdam team that already built at scale: Robert Brighton, years in deep-tech GTM including Microsoft’s Quantum and HoloLens work in Europe; Khalid Benrafik, 14+ years on high-throughput systems at Booking dot com, ING, and Mollie. 

Vangrid is an NVIDIA Inception member. 

A $9M seed from HashKey Capital, Animoca Brands, Borderless Capital, Crypto dot com Capital, Gate Labs, and Mapleblock Capital was announced only after the network was already running.

Physical AI is becoming the next major narrative.

phones are already in the places robots still cannot see, and onchain settlement is how you coordinate and prove the capture.

2104469350489239849.text:
Vangrid (@vangrid_io) is a DePIN network that turns ordinary phones into edge nodes to collect ground-level spatial data for Physical AI. Satellites and mapping fleets miss stairwells, loading bays, and warehouse interiors; Vangrid fills that gap by letting contributors record short videos that get reconstructed into verified 3D models.

Organizations (or AI agents) post funded bounties in USDC on Base; contributors fulfill them and get paid on acceptance. Every capture is fingerprinted at source and batch-anchored onchain via EAS so buyers can check provenance independently. Privacy filters (faces, plates) run on-device. The public explorer currently shows over 1M captures and hundreds of thousands in USDC settlements. Team includes CEO Robert Brighton (ex-Microsoft Quantum/HoloLens GTM) and CTO Khalid Benrafik (https://t.co/SHyAXPddxJ, ING). Raised $9M seed (HashKey, Animoca, https://t.co/iP5YX2wLum Capital and others). $VAN is planned for verification collateral and settlement but is not live.

Positive: real demand-side payments and onchain provenance are already running, not just points. Risk: supply of captures currently far outpaces paid bounties, and fuller verification layers (device attestation, collateralized review) are still forthcoming.

A practical early attempt at scalable, verifiable ground truth for robotics and world models—worth watching the explorer more than the pitch.

The hardware is still sitting there.

Decades after Neil Armstrong’s bootprint, the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter flew low over the Sea of Tranquility, Hadley Rille, Taurus-Littrow and the other Apollo sites. From 20–50 kilometers up, its cameras resolved the lunar module descent stages, the dark trails of rover tracks, the glint of experiment packages, and even the shadows of flags.

These are not fuzzy smudges. At the Apollo 11 site the Eagle descent stage sits beside Little West Crater, and the dark path the astronauts walked is still visible in the soil. At Apollo 17 the Challenger descent stage stands amid a web of rover tracks that stretch for kilometers; the parked Lunar Roving Vehicle itself is a distinct bright speck. The same details appear at every other landing site.

The pictures were taken by a camera built and operated at Arizona State University. Japan’s Kaguya, India’s Chandrayaan-2 and South Korea’s Danuri independently imaged the same hardware. Lasers fired from Earth still bounce off the retroreflectors the crews left behind. The rocks they brought home have been studied in laboratories around the world.

The hoax version requires that every one of those spacecraft, every foreign space agency, and every laser observatory is in on the same lie. The simpler explanation is the one the images show: we went.

Apollo 11 landing site: Eagle descent stage and nearby craters.

Apollo 17 site: Challenger descent stage, rover tracks, experiment package, and the parked rover.
Detailed low-orbit view of the Apollo 17 landing area.

The landers are still there. The tracks are still there. The argument is not.

IPO Verdict
Moneyview Ltd

I am Applying for Reasonable Listing Gains & Short Term

▫️Moneyview is one of India's Largest Digital only Retail Finance Platforms catering to the Middle class people segment

- They Provide Personal Loans (upto 10 lakhs) and Recently diversified into secured products like LAP and also introduced Products like EWA, Credit Cards, Digital Gold, FD Marketplace, General Insurance, UPI and more

▫️ From Customer On-boarding to Risk Assessment to Disbursement and Collection, Everything is Digital. They uses AI/ML for Risk Profiling and hence their Digital Infra Spending is one of the main expenses of the business

▫️They Follow two models for giving out borrowings: 
1) On-Book 
In which the company gives out loans via its NBFC subsidiary and hence loans reflect on their own books. 25% AUM is on-book

2) Off-Book
They act as an LSP and connects other Banks/NBFCs with borrowers on their platform hence loans are recorder on partner's books. 75% AUM is off-book

▫️Moneyview's Disbursals and AUM is Growing at Healthy rates and hence Revenue and Profitability is increasing

- The Company is also able to cross sell its products to the existing users and customer stickiness is good

▫️IPO Proceeds (Fresh: 750 Cr) will be used for providing DLGs to groe off-book AUM (325 Cr) and for the purpose of augmenting capital base of NBFC subsidiary (250 Cr), rest for GCP

▫️ Due to Focus on Growing on-book AUM, Their GNPAs and Impairment are going up. Although their default losses are among lowest in the peer set but still some Asset Quality deterioration is visible

- Balance Sheet Quality is Fine. CEO took a special 160 Cr Incentive which counted as an Exceptional item in FY26. Big Amount! Also he is selling via OFS

▫️ Valuation
The Company is Coming at ~2.3x Post Money FY26 Price to Book (P/B)

If we consider 30% PAT Growth for next two years then FY28E (P/B) comes at 1.5-1.6x

Recently Listed Kissht trades at ~1.8x FY28E Price to Book (P/B)

Kissht should command some Premium Multiple over Moneyview due to Small AUM Base, Better Asset Quality, Higher On-Book AUM (50%) and Higher Margins. Kissht will be growing its Numbers at much better pace

Even if we give both 2x FY28 PB then Upside for Moneyview comes out near 35-40%

If this Sector re rates further then we can see some better multiples for both the players

So, At IPO Price Valuations seem Reasonable but not very Attractive

▫️ Management is Strong and Anchor Book was Good

▫️ Risks
- High Default Risk in this space
- Previous Deterioration in Asset Quality
- Cyber security issues in Past
- High Regulatory Interventions
- Intense Competition from both Organised and Unorganised players
- Supply Overhang post IPO

▫️ Conclusion
Moneyview is a Good Company which is into High Sectorial Tailwinds segment

Good Positioning and Sticky customers

Keeping a view of Short Term because if stock lists very high then Valuation Scope would be minimal

I still feel Kissht would garner a Higher Multiple in Longer Term

(Note: Post is Shared for Educational Purposes Only, DYDD before Applying)
